tips.text: Side with the Grineer on the invasion; a Sheev part usually shares an invasion with a Corpus-side reward.
Run one side of a stalled invasion repeatedly to push it to completion, Grineer side only.
Wait for the Nights of Naberus shop and spend the 200 tokens; Invasion drops are slow and each attempt costs three missions.
Players call it a mediocre dagger; nobody grinds it for power, only for Mastery and the collection.
